title: One Piece Teases Big Dub Updates Are Coming Very Soon
content: One Piece ‘s Elbaph Arc is all set for another hiatus after releasing this year’s episodes. Last year, the anime adapted a seasonal schedule for the first time since its debut in 1999. The anime has always had a weekly schedule, which severely impacted the pacing and the animation.
author: ComicBook

title: Prinny Party: Going Overboard! Game Launches on November 11
content: NIS America announced on Wednesday it will release Nippon Ichi Software 's Prinny Party: Going Overboard! ( Minna de Poitto! Prinny Sugoroku ) party game in the west on November 11 for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and PC via Steam . A playable demo for the game is available now.
author: ANN

title: Shueisha Games Reveals Hoshin Engi Roguelite Game
content: During the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday, Shueisha Games and LASTWONDER announced Hoshin Engi Re:surrection , a roguelite game based on Ryū Fujisaki 's Hoshin Engi manga , for the Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Steam in 2027.
author: ANN

title: New Naruto Anime Film Announcement Expected at New York Comic Con 2026 (Variety)
content: A new anime film for the NARUTO franchise is expected to be announced at New York Comic Con 2026, according to an exclusive report from Variety. The news will be part of a franchise panel taking place on October 10 at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York.
author: Anime Corner

title: Square Enix Unveils Final Fantasy VII Revelation Game's Trailer, Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion Remaster's Switch 2 Version
content: Square Enix unveiled during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday two trailers for games in the Final Fantasy VII series. The first video is for Final Fantasy VII Revelation , the third and final game in the Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy, and it shows Sephiroth.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon Game's HD Version Announced for Same Day Release
content: Square Enix announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream a release of the Dragon Quest Heroes: Torneko's Mystery Dungeon -Classic HD- game for the first time in the West. The game launched on the same day as the announcement for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam .
author: ANN

title: Square Enix Announces Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Remake Game
content: Square Enix annnounced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that the 1995 Romancing SaGa 3 game is getting a remake titled Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam on February 16.
author: ANN

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game's Trailers Reveal Switch 2 Version, Tokyo Revengers DLC Characters
content: SNK announced during the Nintendo Direct livestream on Wednesday that it will release its Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game for Nintendo Switch 2 digitally on October 22 and physically in January 2027.
